label: Unité revolver
incarnation: Original 3.2m personalised fully mechanical revolver unit derived from MGS1 Ocelot: tan angular coat-tail hull panels, dark navy/charcoal structural chassis, red throat command housing, silver swept sensor crest and grille abstracting grey ponytail/moustache, mechanical right-arm six-chamber revolver mechanism; no human skin or cloth anatomy and not a released Metal Gear.
qualification: RIGHT V1 rejected for lowkick border/alpha separation. Corrected native RIGHT V2 preserved; all originals retained.
